complexity.notes: decode(s) copies the remaining suffix on every iteration (s = s[...:]), making it O(T^2) in the total encoded length; an index pointer into the original string would make it linear. Also 'List' requires 'from typing import List'.
complexity.summary: Encode prefixes each string with its length and a '|' separator; decode repeatedly parses the length header and slices out that many characters. Decoding is quadratic because each iteration re-slices the entire remaining encoded string, copying it.
